data.name: Enoch
data.gender_notes: Enoch is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Enoch means 'teacher' or 'instruction'. In the Bible, Enoch is described as a man who walked with God and was translated, or taken up to heaven alive. The name Enoch carries the meaning “Taught by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Enoch usually hope their child will grow to embody taught by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of enlightenment, wisdom, and divine connection.
data.etymology: Enoch belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Taught by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Enoch total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: חֲנוֹך
in_hebrew.meaning: חֲנוֹךְ הוא שם שפרושו דעת או הקדוש
in_hebrew.long_meaning: חֲנוֹךְ הוא שם מקראי הנזכר בספר בראשית, ומשמעותו היא דעת או הקדוש, הוא היה בן ירד ואבי מתושלח, והוא חי 365 שנים, ונלקח אל האלוהים

in_greek.name: Ἐνώχ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἐνώχ ἐστιν ὄνομα Ὀδigos τοῦ Βιβλίου τῆς Γένεσης, καὶ ἔχει τὴν σημασίαν τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως ἢ τῆς ἁγιοσύνης, ἦν υἱὸς Ιαρέδ καὶ πατὴρ Μαθουσαλά, καὶ ἔζησεν 365 ἔτη, καὶ ἀνήχθη πρὸς τὸν Θεόν

in_latin.name: Enoch
in_latin.long_meaning: Enoch est nomen Biblicum quod invenitur in libro Geneseos, et habet significationem scientiae vel sanctitatis, fuit filius Iared et pater Mathusala, et vixit 365 annos, et assumptus est a Deo

in_english.name: Enoch
in_english.meaning: Enoch means knowledge or divine spirit
in_english.long_meaning: Enoch is a biblical name found in the book of Genesis, and it signifies knowledge or divine spirit, he was the son of Jared and the father of Methuselah, and he lived 365 years, and was taken by God

data.cultural_impact: The name Enoch has been a subject of fascination in various cultures throughout history. In Jewish tradition, Enoch is considered to be a great and powerful prophet, whose writings and teachings influenced the development of Rabbinic Judaism. In Christian traditions, Enoch is often considered an example of a person who was God-fearing and obedient, and who was rewarded for his faithfulness. In modern times, the name Enoch has been given to various churches and religious organizations that emphasize the importance of spiritual teaching and learning.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Bible, Enoch is described as a man who pleased God and was taken up to heaven alive, without experiencing death. This event is seen as a sign of Enoch's righteousness and faith, and is often used as a source of inspiration for those who seek to live a Godly life. Many Christians view Enoch as a model of a life that is pleasing to God, and strive to emulate his faith and obedience. Additionally, Enoch is believed to have possessed great wisdom and knowledge, and his teachings are seen as a source of guidance and instruction for those who seek to follow in his footsteps.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Enoch, meaning "teaching" or "dedicated to teaching," is a name given to the ancient biblical figure who walked with God and was taken directly into heaven, bypassing death. His life embodied a deep connection to divine wisdom and knowledge.

biblical_reference.note: Enoch is mentioned in the Bible as a righteous man who walked with God

historical_references.reference: In the Bible, Enoch is the seventh generation from Adam and is described as a righteous man who walked with God.
historical_references.context: The biblical account of Enoch is found in the book of Genesis and is considered a significant figure in the history of Christianity.

trends: increasing popularity as a given name
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Enoch remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Enoch from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Enoch - "Taught by God". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
